scope.zh: 多来源发现与作者归属案例审核（模型身份未独立核验）
scope.en: Multi-source discovery and creator-attributed case review (backend identity unverified)

limitations: Every accepted case is an original creator post explicitly attributing the work to Fable 5.5; this does not verify backend model identity or alleged silent routing.
No official release date, specs, pricing or general model ranking are inferred. Posts saying maybe, rumors and reposts were not accepted.
Discovery, media screening and post reading are bounded. No exhaustive platform coverage, full video viewing or independent reproduction is claimed.

Deployment reconciles with the newer remote baseline. Existing editorial content and withdrawn slots are retained. Local metric snapshots are applied only when newer; this deployment does not perform a fresh crawl.
